title: Charlie’s Chalk Dust | SALTS | Key Lime Pie 60ml
description:
Charlie’s Chalk Dust | SALTS | Key Lime Pie 60ml
Charlie’s Salts Key Lime Pie:
Zesty and sharp key lime splendor slaps your palate directly as soon as you inhale. Smooth creaminess joins combines with citrus lime to soak your tongue. With every exhale, the graham cracker crust satisfies with its buttery, sugary splendor.
Pacha Mama E Juices come at 0 MG Nicotine Level and is perfect for all-day vaping.
This E-Liquid line from Charlie’s Chalk Dust is not to be missed. Also, check out other e juice flavours from Pacha Mama Salts SubOhm.
Flavour Profile
: lime, cream, pastry
VG/PG
: 70/30
Nicotine
: 0MG
Bottle Size
: 60ml
